description: Where can holders of a given passport travel without a visa? Lists every destination grouped by requirement: visa-free (with allowed stay days), visa on arrival, e-visa, eTA — plus counts for visa-required and no-admission. Optional filter to a single category. Answers "visa-free countries for X passport holders". Data: Passport Index snapshot (2026-02-18). Example: visa_free_destinations({ passport: "Germany" })

passport.description: Passport / nationality — ISO2, ISO3, or country name

requirement.description: Optional: return only destinations in this category (default: full lists for visa_free, visa_on_arrival, e_visa, eta, plus counts for the rest)

name: visa_free_destinations
title: Visa Free Destinations
